levels.title: Songs from 2023 only
levels.task: The IT team at Stellar Sound is testing speed. Pull SELECT * for songs whose release_date is in 2023 (from '2023-01-01' through '2023-12-31'). ORDER BY release_date, then id. Small filters help big tables run fast later.
levels.initialCode: -- WHERE release_date between the first and last day of 2023
levels.solution:
SELECT *
FROM top_songs
WHERE release_date >= '2023-01-01' AND release_date <= '2023-12-31'
ORDER BY release_date, id;
levels.hintMessage: Dates are text like '2023-04-11'. Use >= '2023-01-01' AND <= '2023-12-31'. ORDER BY release_date, id.
levels.successMessage: Great! You asked for one year only—not the whole table.

levels.title: Shows at venue 1
levels.task: Festival ops at Stellar Sound needs every column for venue_id = 1, sorted by set_time. This is a small slice of the stage table.
levels.initialCode: -- SELECT * FROM festival_performances WHERE venue_id = 1 ORDER BY set_time
levels.solution:
SELECT *
FROM festival_performances
WHERE venue_id = 1
ORDER BY set_time;
levels.hintMessage: WHERE venue_id = 1 then ORDER BY set_time.
levels.successMessage: Nice! Short WHERE lists stay quick when data grows.

levels.title: Venues in Chicago
levels.task: Tour planning at Stellar Sound: show every column for venues in Chicago. Sort by biggest capacity first, then venue name A–Z.
levels.solution:
SELECT *
FROM venues
WHERE city = 'Chicago'
ORDER BY capacity DESC, name;
levels.hintMessage: WHERE city = 'Chicago' ORDER BY capacity DESC, name.
levels.successMessage: Good! City filters are common when crews plan travel between shows.

levels.title: Songs on the chart many weeks
levels.task: Radio partners at Stellar Sound want songs that stayed on the chart between 15 and 25 weeks (include 15 and 25). Show all columns. ORDER BY weeks_on_chart, then id.
levels.solution:
SELECT *
FROM top_songs
WHERE weeks_on_chart BETWEEN 15 AND 25
ORDER BY weeks_on_chart, id;
levels.hintMessage: BETWEEN 15 AND 25 includes both 15 and 25. Add ORDER BY weeks_on_chart, id.
levels.successMessage: Great! BETWEEN picks a number range in one short line.

levels.title: Headliner list
levels.task: Print day-of-show style: from festival_performances, every column where headliner = 1. Sort by venue_id, then set_time.
levels.initialCode: -- WHERE headliner = 1 ORDER BY venue_id, set_time
levels.solution:
SELECT *
FROM festival_performances
WHERE headliner = 1
ORDER BY venue_id, set_time;
levels.hintMessage: headliner uses 1 for yes and 0 for no. Use WHERE headliner = 1. ORDER BY venue_id, set_time.
levels.successMessage: Perfect! You still need ORDER BY even when the story says "main act first."
